title: Financial Literacy Training Programme
summary: Financial Literacy Training Programme organised by Rotary Club of Mumbai Glocal at Amcha Ghar NGO, Uttan led by Rtn Chetan Budhia and attended by Rtn Rajendran Unnikrishnan & Rtn Tirup Kawa & Sahil Budhia.
description:
Financial Literacy Training Programme organised by Rotary Club of Mumbai Glocal at Amcha Ghar NGO, Uttan led by Rtn Chetan Budhia and attended by Rtn Rajendran Unnikrishnan & Rtn Tirup Kawa & Sahil Budhia. The programme witnessed an enthusiastic participation of approximately 120 students and 45 teachers, making it a highly engaging and impactful initiative.
The interactive format encouraged active participation from both students and teachers, with engaging discussions and practical examples that made financial concepts easy to understand and relate to everyday life. The positive response from the participants reaffirmed the growing need for financial education at the grassroots level.
